Class Node

java.lang.Object
solvers.queueingnet.treeAlgorithms.Node

    • childrenSuitableForFeedbackFiltering

      public boolean childrenSuitableForFeedbackFiltering(QNModel qnm)
      Checks whether this node is suitable for feedback filtering. This will be true if: 1. Both children are leaf nodes. 2. At least one is a fixed-rate station.
      Parameters:
      qnm - The queueing network model being solved.
      Returns:
      A boolean indicating whether this node is suitable for feedback filtering.

    • childrenOverlappedPcsHaveLargePopulation

      public boolean childrenOverlappedPcsHaveLargePopulation(PopulationVector popVec)
      Checks whether this node's children have a large population overlap in their partially covered classes. This is defined to be true if the overlap is greater than the FEEDBACK_FILTERING_OVERLAP_POP_THRESHOLD constant defined in Config.
      Parameters:
      popVec - The full population vector.
      Returns:
      A boolean indicating whether the population overlap is large.
